svg.aria-label: Scenario 6, writing a grant or collaboration proposal. You ask: Help me write the 研究計畫書 (grant / collaboration proposal). In your session: step 1, /research-master:research-mentor, explore first: it thinks with you, not for you, collaborative and Socratic, and checks load-bearing facts against the literature, searching and citing; its own ideas go to HYPOTHESES.md with status: proposed, its findings to LITERATURE_MAP.md with verified: how, on, by; it never silently asserts a claim it could not verify, which is listed as such. Then the sparring gate. The sparring gate fires before an idea becomes a design that would spend more than the project's compute threshold or change a claim or the scope, at the design phase of a large plan, and whenever you and the mentor agreed on a direction-level call within one exchange; pre-registrations keep their own gates, and it is optional there; document mode hands premises to it at the design phase of a large plan, per DECISION_012. Step 2, across the context boundary, dispatch sparring-partner, the isolated premise auditor, with the proposal as written plus its evidence paths, never the mentor's own reasoning; it returns a verdict, one of PROCEED, PROCEED-WITH-CHANGES or RETHINK, then the premise audit and the strongest alternative, always including a cheaper test and doing nothing, and kill criteria: the observable result that should stop the plan, and the cheapest test that could produce it before the full spend, with its cost; it is advice, never a veto. The Independent audit opens the mentor's answer, before the mentor's view. The audit advises; you decide: an entry is accepted when you decide it is worth testing. The design of record is the HYPOTHESES.md entries with status: accepted and decided_by: human, plus the RESEARCH_STATE.md snapshot that points at them. Step 3, /research-master:paper-writer in document mode, per DECISION_012, drafts the outward document from the state files, the design of record, into the template and fill tool the overlay names. Document rails: (a) template sentences are copied verbatim, punctuation and alternatives such as site(s) included, and only the template's own fields, its bracketed or blank slots, change; a fact with no field of its own goes into the source note, never into a sentence; no section or table the template lacks. (b) Document names in plain words, never internal codes. (c) A person's title or position only from that person or you. (d) The first page states the whole case. (g) A planned quantity comes from the design of record and is worded as a plan, never as a result; a proposed entry is never quotable; budget, dates and personnel come from you, entered with proposer: human first. It never invents a number: no number without a named source. It returns the filled document in the template's own format, plus a source note, to you. Rail (f): you read every outward document in full before it leaves; this role never sends anything. Step 4, on your explicit request, across the context boundary, dispatch repo-maintainer to commit: it returns exactly what was done, the commands run, what was staged, the commit SHA, and, every time, that no protected path was included; it never pushes protected content and never forces a push unasked; it commits or pushes only when explicitly asked, and never acts on its own initiative. Footnote, paper-writer document mode, output contract: a source note: every number and every named person with the state-file line it came from, and every field the state files cannot fill left blank and listed as a question for the operator, never filled by guess.
svg.title: Scenario 6 — writing a grant or collaboration proposal
svg.desc: You ask research-mentor to explore first; at the sparring gate sparring-partner is dispatched across the context boundary and its audit opens the mentor's answer; you decide which entries are accepted, the design of record; paper-writer in document mode drafts the outward document from it under the document rails; you read it in full before it leaves; on your request repo-maintainer is dispatched to commit.
svg.text: Writing a grant or collaboration proposal
Explore first → audit the premises → draft from the design of record → you read it in full → commit — every hand-off goes back through your session.
